actions.action: Check permission for the actual installation
actions.mechanism: An asset identifier resolves to permission for the selected venue and display dates, not universal approval.
actions.implementation: Print only the asset ID and verification URL on public labels. Require venue staff to select venue and dates before checking.
actions.check: Test authorized, withdrawn, wrong-venue, and partially authorized date ranges; only fully authorized selections pass.
actions.risk: Copied labels require matching the identifier to the physical print.

actions.action: Keep withdrawals as dated, append-only events
actions.mechanism: Preserving grants and withdrawals separately distinguishes past authorized display from permission for future display.
actions.implementation: Record asset ID, affected venue/date scope, receipt time, effective time, and event ID; derive current permission without deleting earlier records.
actions.check: After withdrawal, verify affected future dates fail while an earlier authorized installation and its original permission evidence remain retrievable.
actions.risk: Incorrect effective times or scope can misclassify permission.

actions.mechanism: Cached permission supports packing decisions, but reconciliation—not packing—determines whether a print can proceed to installation.
actions.implementation: Cache a versioned manifest for one workday. Queue asset, destination, dates, and cached version for each packing decision; require synchronization before installation.
actions.check: Withdraw permission during an offline shift; synchronization must flag the packed print and block installation clearance.
actions.risk: If connectivity remains unavailable, installation must wait.

actions.action: Intercept withdrawn prints already in transit
actions.mechanism: Shipment-level holds turn a permission change into a physical handling task without requiring contributor contact details.
actions.implementation: Link asset IDs to crates and destinations. On withdrawal, create a hold task for affected shipments; require receiving staff to scan and segregate flagged prints.
actions.check: Withdraw a packed asset; confirm its destination receives the hold and records segregation before installation clearance.
actions.risk: Unrecorded crate changes can send holds to the wrong shipment.
